svg.title: hermitcrab in action
svg.desc: A tiny cartoon hermit crab walks around inside a sandboxed browser: it taps the username and password fields and logs in, adds the cheapest item to the cart and checks the cart, waits for human approval before pressing Finish, then celebrates the order confirmation. A side panel shows the code the crab's brain writes for each step.
svg.text: a tiny crab that does your web errands inside a sealed shell
the shell: sandbox container, no keys, allowlisted sites only

g.text: 1. The crab logs in. Its code runs in the shell, and the password stays a secret name.
2. It finds the cheapest item, adds it, and checks the cart. A verifier confirms it worked.
Approved by a human. Clicking Finish
3. Finish places a real order, so the run pauses until a human approves it.
4. Done. The working steps are saved as a skill, and the shell is thrown away.
